description: This file contains functions to manage systemd user lingering settings, including interactive and non-interactive methods, with external dependencies on systemd control functions, runtime environment, and terminal notifications.

methods.name: ensureSystemdUserLingerInteractive
methods.description: Interactively enables systemd user lingering with optional confirmation, handling different system states and errors.

methods.name: ensureSystemdUserLingerNonInteractive
